pitfalls.title: initial_routing_facts_require_code_confirmation
symptoms: routing facts are broader than verified code behavior
future agents treat bootstrap anchors as grounded implementation facts
trigger_actions: edit routing facts before sampling code
check_before_edit: read sampled code before promoting facts
keep fact_status as needs_code_confirmation until verified

pitfalls.title: routing_files_are_machine_owned_contracts
trigger_actions: edit AGENTS.md or docs routing JSON
check_before_edit: keep routing facts in JSON owners
run evolve and validate after routing changes

pitfalls.title: macro_observation_units_and_physical_proof
symptoms: 将月或季度所属日期当公布日
空值填零或跨缺月计算同比、非农新增
将 Mac HTTP 200 或交叉编译当作实机联网、语音验证
trigger_actions: 修改宏观指标目录、CSV 解析及单位换算
修改宏观缓存、消息或换页按键
blast_radius: 共享 App 协议编号
check_before_edit: 同比要求去年同月，非农要求上一日历月；空值不作零
利率差用bp，百分比指标差用百分点；中国、美国、商品各固定6项，宏观不支持语音添加或删除
保持远端 main 的 App 编号；对讲机为 46，宏观顺延为 47
FRED 公共 CSV 与需 Key 的 REST API 不同，下载规则改变时重新适配
safe_observation_methods: 运行宿主解析器 ASan/UBSan 测试及固件构建
实机网络、按键、缓存重启和 RAM 峰值需独立验证，构建不替代验收

pitfalls.title: A paired badge can retain the protocol while changing its Bluetooth name
symptoms: macOS shows a connected badge while the companion waits indefinitely
The required GATT services exist but the name differs from the original MAC-derived name
A dictation page can wait even though the encrypted BLE link never disconnected.
trigger_actions: Reconnect a previously USB-paired badge through BLE
check_before_edit: Inspect the connected peripheral and required services
Authenticate a read-only status request with the existing pairing credential before pinning the identifier
Do not select an arbitrary peripheral with a matching service or expose pairing credentials
Compare BLE connect/disconnect counters across page changes before blaming pairing.
Notification registrations belong to a BLE client connection, not a page; reuse them until that client disconnects.
Retries must stop on permission failure or a stale page generation.
Keep full-status freshness separate from authenticated link contact; successful RPC traffic is evidence of a live connection even when a large status response is delayed.
safe_observation_methods: Enumerate CoreBluetooth connected peripherals and GATT services
Read authenticated /status through the pinned identity
